description.en: The ID of the IPv6 gateway.

description.zh:
IPv6网关的名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the IPv6 gateway.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The number of the page to return.
The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh: IPv6网关所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
The ID of the resource group to which the IPv6 gateway belongs.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the VPC associated with the IPv6 gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-ipv6-gateways --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-gateway-id ipv6gw-hp3rwmtmfhgis0000 --vpc-id vpc-123sedrfswd230000 --name ipv6GW --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeIpv6Gateways --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --VpcId 'vpc-123sedrfswd230000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --PageNumber 1 --Ipv6GatewayId 'ipv6gw-hp3rwmtmfhgis0000' --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name ipv6GW
